summary: Sprott Physical Platinum and Palladium Trust filed Form 6-K with interim financial statements and management report of fund performance as of June 30, 2026. The filing reports routine operational results including unrealized losses on platinum and palladium bullion holdings. No corporate transaction, strategic review, or special-situation event is described. The filing is a standard periodic disclosure for a closed-end fund and does not involve acquisition, divestiture, tender, spin-off, or other special-situation category. The registrant acts merely as the filer of its routine financial report.
